Container.Name: secure-media-gallery
Container.Overview: End-to-end encrypted photo and video albums. Files, file names and thumbnails are encrypted in the browser; the server only stores ciphertext. Share albums with other users, stream large videos, install it as an app on phones.[br][br]The container serves plain HTTP on port 5000. Browsers only allow the encryption API on HTTPS, so put any HTTPS reverse proxy in front (Nginx Proxy Manager, SWAG, Traefik, Caddy, Cloudflare Tunnel, …) and set "Trusted proxies" accordingly; see the project README, section "Behind an HTTPS reverse proxy". On first start the container log shows an invite key for the first account. More invite keys: open the container console and run "manage create-invite".
Container.Requires: An HTTPS reverse proxy of your choice in front of the HTTP port. Only the proxy should be able to reach that port, otherwise the login rate limiting can be evaded (see README).

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Database, encrypted uploads and the generated secret key. Back up this whole folder; neither half is usable without the other.

Config.Name: HTTP port
Config.Description: Plain HTTP. Point your HTTPS reverse proxy here; it should be the only thing that can reach this port.

Config.Name: Trusted proxies
Config.Description: How many reverse proxies are between the browser and this container (one HTTPS proxy: 1; Cloudflare proxy + your proxy: 2; none: 0). The proxies must send X-Forwarded-For and X-Forwarded-Proto. Needed for the per-IP login rate limiting and HTTPS detection; the container log warns if it doesn't match.

Config.Name: Secret key
Config.Description: Signs login sessions. Leave empty: a key is generated on first start and kept in the data folder. If set: at least 32 random characters (e.g. output of: openssl rand -hex 32).

Config.Name: Max file size
Config.Description: Largest single file, e.g. 20G or 500M. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: Storage quota per user
Config.Description: Storage per user: everything in the albums they own, including files other members upload there. e.g. 100G. 0 = unlimited.

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: Owner of the data folder (Unraid: 99 = nobody).

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group of the data folder (Unraid: 100 = users).

Config.Name: Minimum free disk space
Config.Description: Uploads that would leave less free space in the data folder are refused.

Config.Name: Unfinished upload expiry (hours)
Config.Description: Interrupted uploads can be resumed for this long, then they are deleted.

Config.Name: Album previews on dashboard
Config.Description: Show decrypted preview images on the album cards (true/false).

Config.Name: Server tuning
Config.Description: Extra gunicorn options, e.g. --workers 4 --threads 8 (default: 2 workers x 4 threads).

Config.Name: Secure cookies
Config.Description: Keep true when using the app through HTTPS. false only for testing over plain http://localhost.
